steps.label: 3120-own-twin-merge-unlink-modal-dismiss
command: (async()=>{const m=document.querySelector('#itemTwinModal'),i=bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(m);if(!m.classList.contains('show')||i._isTransitioning)throw Error('Stable twin modal required');const done=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Twin hide timeout')),7000);m.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});m.querySelector('.modal-header [data-bs-dismiss=modal]').click();await done;return {visibleModals:[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show')].map(e=>e.id)};})()
